description: Repairs r-def-cat-txn/enc-newpassword-shared-and-readonly-opens: both NewPassword calls were refused (3621, 3027), so the file was never protected and every later password open ran against an unprotected file. A new ACCDB with T (3 rows) is given the password 'pw-base' by NewPassword('', 'pw-base') on an exclusive open (DBEngine.Errors right before and after); it is opened with no password, with ';pwd=pw-base' and counted. Then, on the protected file: NewPassword('pw-base', 'pw-shared') on a SHARED read/write open with ';pwd=pw-base', then (after closing) opens with no password, 'pw-base' and 'pw-shared'; then NewPassword('pw-shared', 'pw-ro') on an EXCLUSIVE READ-ONLY open with ';pwd=pw-shared', then opens with no password, 'pw-shared' and 'pw-ro'. Each open is counted; DBEngine.Errors right before and after each call.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
